Breadcrumb

Path trail for file-tree and web-preview headers. A horizontal ScrollView, not the web's wrap-and-ellipsis: a phone bar overflows before it wraps.

  • v0.2.1
  • ui
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/breadcrumb.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/breadcrumb.json

Dependencies

No required npm packages — this item installs through the registry dependencies below.

https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/text.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/icon.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/text.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/icon.json

The TextClassContext seam

This component publishes its class strings through the TextClassContext provider, so a parent view can restyle its nested text.
